#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""verify-app helper: launch, doctor, drive, cleanup. Evidence: .verify/evidence/<run>/ of this checkout."""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True).stdout.strip()
EVIDENCE = os.path.join(ROOT, ".verify", "evidence")
CURRENT = os.path.join(ROOT, ".verify", "current")


def main(step):
    if step == "launch":
        run = time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", time.gmtime()) + "-app"
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(EVIDENCE, run), exist_ok=True)
        head = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", ROOT, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True).stdout
        write(run, "commit: %s\n" % head.strip())
        with open(CURRENT, "w") as fh:
            fh.write(run)
        print("run: %s" % run)
        return 0
    run = open(CURRENT).read().strip()
    if step == "doctor":
        ok = os.path.isfile(os.path.join(ROOT, "app", "cli.py"))
        write(run, "doctor: %s\n" % ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"))
        print("checkout: %s\ndoctor: %s" % (ROOT, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"))
        return 0 if ok else 1
    if step == "drive":
        cli = "import sys; sys.argv = ['app.cli', '2', '3']; from app.cli import main; main()"
        res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", cli], cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        with open(os.path.join(EVIDENCE, run, "drive.txt"), "w") as fh:
            fh.write(res.stdout)
        print("app.cli main 2 3 -> %s (expect 5)" % res.stdout.strip())
        return 0 if res.stdout.strip() == "5" else 1
    if step == "cleanup":
        write(run, "db_writes: no\nfinished: %s\n" % time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()))
        os.remove(CURRENT)
        print("evidence kept: %s" % os.path.join(EVIDENCE, run))
        return 0
    print(__doc__)
    return 2


def write(run, text):
    with open(os.path.join(EVIDENCE, run, "run.log"), "a") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ""))
